name: AECi — page_views write error rate > 10% (10m)
message:
More than 10% of `POST /api/page-views` inserts failed over 10m (AECI-177 write path). The endpoint already returned 204 to every caller, so this is user-invisible — but `page_views` is the only source for `home.trending_products`, so a sustained insert regression silently zeroes trending at the next 07:00 UTC daily compute. Catching the write error rate makes the regression visible *before* the home page goes blank. Read the `aeci.api.page_view.capture_failed` logs (`service:aeci-api`, `source:page-views`) for the `reason`.

Note: this is an error-*rate* monitor and deliberately does NOT use notify_no_data — page_views is traffic-driven, so zero writes (no visitors) is normal at pre-launch and a liveness/no-data alert here would fire constantly. Only the failure *ratio* is meaningful. The 10% threshold is a launch-tunable starting point (§14.3 cites 1% for request error rate; page_views runs at far lower volume, so the floor is set higher to avoid single-failure noise) — retune once production traffic is known.

Runbook: https://github.com/the-wbs-project/aec-integrations/blob/main/docs/RUNBOOKS.md#page-view-writes-failing
